reviewAudit.thesis: 38,000 structural level held on the first pullback after the October breakout; 10/7 closed near the session low, so acceptance still needs confirmation.
Rising medium-term structure remains intact, but repeated rejection around 161,200-164,700 leaves price directly below established supply.
The late-September expansion is testing 78,100, a prior event-close/role-reversal level near the 120-day average; 10/7 showed upper rejection.
Price is oscillating between the 1,098,000 trend-bridge support and repeated 1.20m supply; 10/7 again rejected the upper area.
The 256,000-293,000 September box has broken upward, but two-session expansion leaves the 10/7 close materially extended from 293,000.
The 164,700 prior-high area has been reclaimed within an aligned medium-term trend; 10/7 made a fresh 173,700 test but did not fully clear it.
The 36,412 role-reversal level remains intact after a low-volume 10/7 pullback; the close at 36,800 is close enough for a clean structural test.
Price advanced from the mid-12,000s to about 20,000 in a short window with sustained volume expansion; it is now far from the original 18,100 structure.
The September stair-step advance remains constructive, but 10/7 rejected 336,000 and closed at 310,000 while structural downside remains wide.
The September advance reclaimed 505,500 and the 10/7 pullback closed just above that role-reversal area after the 10/1 expansion.
The 330,000-387,000 box has broken upward and 10/7 retained 391,000, but dense resistance begins near 402,625 and compresses structural reward.
The chart remains range-bound around the 473,734 density center; 10/7 closed at 469,500 on contracting activity without directional confirmation.

The long-term trend is strong and 15,705 was reclaimed, but the 10/7 surge ran directly into the repeated 17,910 high and closed well off that high; current location is too extended for a clean retest entry.

Price is retesting the repeatedly defended 8,080-8,260 box-floor zone after a weak low-location close; the level is close enough for asymmetric testing, but the broader trend remains below declining MA20/60/120.

The uptrend is intact and 57,500 has been reclaimed, but price has advanced for several sessions into a fresh high with RSI near 70 and bearish divergence while the nearest accepted support is materially lower.
The 20,000 box-floor has absorbed repeated tests and 10/7 again closed just above it; this is a defined-risk support test, though the broader trend remains below MA20/60/120.
The primary trend is powerful but the September-October run is extended far above MA20/60/120; 10/7 rejected from 13,800 and RSI remains above 70, leaving no nearby structural invalidation.

The 302,500 multi-test box floor remains the nearest structural support and offers defined downside, but 10/7 reversed lower from 315,500 and price remains under MA20/60 and dense 316.5k-334.5k overhead supply.
Price is sitting on the 32,800 box floor, but the broader structure is still a persistent downtrend below MA20/60/120/240 and 10/7 closed near the low without a reversal signal.

The long-term uptrend remains constructive, but price is in the middle of a broad decision area around 100k-103.4k with only modest room to the 108.7k-109.7k box resistance and no compelling structural R/R.
The 68,480 box-floor/event-close cluster remains accepted support and 10/7 tested it with expanded activity; the location is defined, but the sharp upper rejection requires recovery confirmation.
The 107.6k support remains intact, but 10/7 rejected the 114.9k area and closed near the low inside a broad 109.35k-114.37k decision zone; immediate direction is unresolved.
The 80.4k-82.4k event-close/swing cluster is a meaningful role-reversal support after the September breakout; 10/7 closed weakly but still held the zone, giving a defined retest setup.
The early-October spring from 129k remains valid, but the rebound has already moved into the 132.5k-143.9k decision/supply zone and current reward to 143.9k is compressed.

The late-September breakout accelerated from 93,300 to 112,400 in five sessions, but 10/7 rejected 113,700 and closed near the low while RSI remains above 70 with bearish divergence; the original breakout level is now too distant for clean asymmetry.
The 46,300-46,400 spring/retest area survived the 10/6 undershoot and 10/7 recovered to 47,850, creating a nearby defined-risk support test after the September decline.

The 3,590 box breakout remains accepted, but the four-session expansion to 4,025 was followed by a 10/7 pullback; current price is still above the breakout yet structural invalidation at 3,225 is too wide for a fresh entry.

The 10/1-10/6 breakout leg expanded roughly 40% from the 170,800 structure and 10/7 printed a high-volume upper rejection from 257,000; despite the strong trend, current location is far beyond any nearby structural invalidation.
The 28,100-28,150 area is being tested after a month-long decline from 33,100; 10/7 touched 28,100 and closed back at 28,250, giving a very tight support-location probe despite weak momentum.

Price has recovered toward the 6,268-6,530 resistance band with expanding activity, but the 6,230 close leaves little immediate room before established supply and the broader base has not yet broken out.
The 33,800-34,250 area has repeatedly contained downside since mid-September and price is again close to that floor; upside toward the 38.7k-39k density offers defined asymmetry if the floor holds.

The September impulse remains visible, but 10/7 fell from 4,030 to a near-low 3,645 close after the 10/6 spike, breaking the short-term recovery rhythm; nearest clean trend-bridge support around 3,185 is still far below.
Price is near the lower portion of the 72,000-82,500 building box after a multi-week decline; 10/6 showed a rebound from 74,400 and 10/7 retained the 74,800 area, allowing a defined lower-box probe.

The September recovery remains above the old 8,350 trend-bridge level, but 10/7 rejected 9,380 and closed near the low at 8,790; the chart is between support and 10,380 resistance without a clean trigger.

The 19,610-19,820 lower box area remains intact after repeated late-September/October tests, and current price at 19,870 is close enough for a tightly defined support probe despite the prevailing downtrend.

The August trend bridge at 11,500 remains the nearest accepted support, but 10/7 rejected 13,420 and closed near the low at 12,370; the current level is between support and the 14,248-14,320 resistance cluster.
